settings.name_in_paper: Stochastic K-armed contextual bandit with QNN/QNTK reward model
unmapped: Mean reward h: R^d -> [0,1] unknown, modeled via quantum neural tangent kernel of a randomly initialized QNN with m qubits; contexts x_{t,a} in R^d with ||x||_2=1
Limiting QNTK Gram matrix over all TK contexts is positive definite (min eigenvalue lambda_0 > 0)
settings.definition_quote: At each round $t$, the agent observes a set of context vectors $\mathcal{X}_t = \{\xbf_{t,a}: a \in [K]\}$ ... $r_{t,a_t}=h(\xbf_{t,a_t})+ \xi_t$, where $h: \mathbb{R}^d \to [0, 1]$ is an unknown, $[0,1]$-bounded, mean reward function and $\xi_t$ is $\nu$-sub-Gaussian noise conditioned on the history

symbols.d_eff: quantum effective dimension log det(I + Kbar/lam)/log(1+TK/lam) of the limiting QNTK on all TK contexts

conditions: number of qubits m = Omega((TK)^3/lam^2 * log((TK)^2/delta)) with a QNN architecture satisfying Assumptions 1-3 (e.g. N(m)=sqrt(m), L=O(log m))
limiting QNTK Gram matrix positive definite with min eigenvalue lambda_0 > 0
tuning: beta_{t-1} = nu*sqrt(log det(Z_{t-1})/det(lam I) + 2 log(1/delta)) + sqrt(lam) S

source.label: thm:regret
source.quote: Fix any $\delta\in(0,1)$. Let $m = \bigOmega\left( \frac{(TK)^3}{\lambda^2}\log\left(\frac{(TK)^2}{\delta}\right) \right)$. Then, with probability at least $1-\delta$, the cumulative regret of QNTK-UCB (Algorithm 1) satisfies R_T \le 3\sqrt{T}\sqrt{\widetilde{d}_{\mathrm{q}}\log (1+\frac{TK}{\lambda})+1}(\nu\sqrt{...+2\log(1/\delta)}+\sqrt{\lambda}S), where $S \geq \sqrt{2\hbf^\top \bar{\Kbf}^{-1} \hbf}$ ... and $\lambda \geq \max\{1,S^{-2}\}$.

results.notes: Probability over both QNN initialization and noise. nu mapped to sigma. Regret defined via mean rewards h (realized pseudo-regret on the event). Effective dimension mapped to d_eff (log-det normalized version, as in NeuralUCB).

symbols.d_eff: quantum effective dimension of the limiting QNTK

conditions: same as Theorem: m = Omega((TK)^3/lam^2 log((TK)^2/delta)), Kbar positive definite, ||x||=1, S >= sqrt(2 h^T Kbar^{-1} h)

source.label: thm:regret
source.quote: Ignoring logarithmic terms and constants, this bound simplifies to $R_T = \tilde{\mathcal{O}}\left(\widetilde{d}_{\mathrm{q}} \sqrt{T} \right)$

results.notes: Simplified form; hides S, nu, lambda dependence.

symbols.d_eff: quantum effective dimension of the limiting QNTK

conditions: same conditions as Theorem (thm:regret) with delta = 1/T

source.quote: Under the same conditions as Theorem~\ref{thm:regret}, the expected cumulative regret satisfies $\bar{R}_T \le 3\sqrt{T}\sqrt{...}\Big(\nu\sqrt{...+2\log T}+\sqrt{\lambda}S\Big) +1 = \tilde{\mathcal{O}}(\widetilde{d}_{\mathrm{q}} \sqrt{T})$

results.notes: Expected regret defined via mean rewards h, so pseudo-regret. Also stated as O_tilde(d_q sqrt(T)).
